name: Oxiquim S.A.
summary: Oxiquim S.A. engages in the production and sale of resins for the wood board industry in Chile. It offers liquid petroleum gas, clean fuels, wood board, animal feed and nutrition, human food, food flexible packaging films, thermoplastic and compostable resins, paints, coating, and adhesives; industrial water, desalination, purification and treatment; pharmaceuticals and cosmetics, mining, detergents and cleaning, cellulose and paper, HPLC solvents and ACS reagents, and other products.
